fields.description: Master switch. When unchecked, the MCP endpoint rejects all requests with a 503.
fields.label: Enabled

fields.description: Refuse plaintext (non-TLS, non-loopback) requests. MCP spec MUST for non-loopback URLs.
fields.label: Require TLS (reject plaintext non-loopback)

fields.description: JSON list of allowed Origin header values (DNS-rebinding defense). A request whose Origin is not in this list is rejected with 403. Entries are matched as prefixes (so ports are allowed).
fields.label: Allowed Origins (JSON list)

fields.description: JSON list of accepted MCP-Protocol-Version header values. An unsupported version is rejected with 400.
fields.label: Allowed Protocol Versions (JSON list)

fields.description: This server's canonical resource URI. Used for RFC 8707 audience binding: a bearer token whose audience does not match this is rejected. Leave blank to skip audience checks (NOT recommended in production).
fields.label: OAuth Resource URI (audience)

fields.description: MCP Audit Log rows older than this are pruned by the daily scheduler.
fields.label: Audit Retention (days)

fields.description: Maximum size of a tool result captured in the audit log (bytes). Larger results are truncated in the log (not in the response).
fields.label: Audit Output Max Bytes
